ORIGINAL REPORT: WHITE LIQUOR RELEASED FROM A STORAGE TANK DUE TO AN UNKNOWN CAUSE AT THIS TIME (IT APPEARS THE TANK POSSIBLY DEVELOPED A LEAK FROM A RUPTURE).
